mapper.select: SELECT id AS source_id, COALESCE(display_name, id) AS name FROM ${schema}.sources WHERE upper(id) = upper(#{q}) OR strpos(lower(display_name), lower(#{q})) > 0 ORDER BY (upper(id) = upper(#{q})) DESC, display_name NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 25

SELECT DISTINCT ON (wa.work_id, wa.author_id) wa.work_id, wa.author_id, a.display_name AS author_name FROM ${schema}.works_authorships wa JOIN ${schema}.authors a ON a.id = wa.author_id WHERE wa.work_id IN #{id} ORDER BY wa.work_id, wa.author_id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (wt.work_id, wt.topic_id) wt.work_id, wt.topic_id, t.display_name AS topic_name, t.field_display_name AS field_name, t.subfield_display_name AS subfield_name, t.domain_display_name AS domain_name FROM ${schema}.works_topics wt JOIN ${schema}.topics t ON t.id = wt.topic_id WHERE wt.work_id IN #{id} ORDER BY wt.work_id, wt.topic_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO work (work_id, publication_year, title, doi) VALUES (#{w.workId}, #{w.year}, #{w.title}, #{w.doi})
ON CONFLICT (work_id) DO UPDATE SET publication_year = EXCLUDED.publication_year, title = EXCLUDED.title, doi = EXCLUDED.doi

INSERT INTO work_source (work_id, source_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{sourceId})
ON CONFLICT (work_id, source_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO work_author (work_id, author_id, author_name) VALUES (#{a.workId}, #{a.authorId}, #{a.authorName})
ON CONFLICT (work_id, author_id) DO UPDATE SET author_name = EXCLUDED.author_name

INSERT INTO work_topic (work_id, topic_id, topic_name, field_name, subfield_name, domain_name) VALUES (#{t.workId}, #{t.topicId}, #{t.topicName}, #{t.fieldName}, #{t.subfieldName}, #{t.domainName})
ON CONFLICT (work_id, topic_id) DO UPDATE SET topic_name = EXCLUDED.topic_name, field_name = EXCLUDED.field_name, subfield_name = EXCLUDED.subfield_name, domain_name = EXCLUDED.domain_name
mapper.sql: SELECT w.work_id, w.publication_year AS year, w.title, w.doi, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(wa.author_name, ';' ORDER BY wa.author_id) FROM work_author wa WHERE wa.work_id = w.work_id), '') AS authors FROM work_source ws JOIN work w ON w.work_id = ws.work_id WHERE ws.source_id = #{sourceId}
mapper.select: AND w.doi IN (#{doi}, 'https://doi.org/' || #{doi}) ORDER BY w.work_id
mapper.update: UPDATE v2_paper SET matched_work_id = #{workId}, record_version = record_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE paper_id = #{paperId}
